summary: The Tehama County Department of Education urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of high-quality broadband in modern public education. The comments highlight the financial burden of maintaining network infrastructure and the impact of reducing or eliminating E-Rate support on schools, particularly in rural areas. TCDE urges the Commission to protect E-Rate’s core structure and discount framework, and to pursue program-integrity improvements in a targeted, phased manner that does not disrupt its ability to serve students.
